## 6a1a8be1f042

**Reproduced defect — advertised palette domain conflicts with runtime and observability.** Assigned generator SHA-256: `fb6441caab00776d2ba03aac9c0399adb87dcf31aed42ceedc63a264ef4a3dd9`. `AXES` advertises `fg_palette_size` 1–9, but an exact override of 9 raises `ValueError: draw_int('fg_palette_size'): override 9 outside [1, 5]`. A requested size of 5 combined with `column_distribution="one_col"` and `value_distribution="same_color"` emitted only one foreground color and passed `self_check`. Evidence: `checks/audit/6a1a8be1f042/report.json` and `probe.py`.

**Reproduced naming/semantic defects in degenerate textures.** `texture="all_bg"` emitted one foreground cell at the top rather than an all-background grid; the validator accepted it and the canonical Racket rule moved that cell to the bottom (`racket-all-bg.json`). `texture="already_at_bottom"` emitted an additional foreground cell above the bottom object, so it was not a no-op/already-settled case; the validator accepted it and the Racket output changed (`racket-already-bottom.json`). Both inputs are in the generator's accepted domain and both canonical applications returned valid outputs.

No repair was applied. Exact inputs, hashes, outputs, commands, and working directories are retained under `checks/audit/6a1a8be1f042/`.
